diagnosis.what_happened: Left alignment inversion on headings, ragged narrative paragraphs, untranslated acronyms, tblPr sequence violations, and false Chapter 5 detection.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Injecting <w:jc w:val='right'/> under <w:bidi w:val='1'/> caused trailing-edge flip inversion. Missing <w:jc w:val='both'/> left text ragged. Using append() put bidiVisual after tblW. Regex for 'فصل پنجم' caught bridge headings.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Omit w:jc completely for RTL headings. Apply w:jc w:val='both' to narrative paragraphs. Use tblPr[0].insert(0, ...) for bidiVisual. Sanitize acronyms. Constrain auditor regex to chapter titles.
diagnosis.rationale_why: OpenXML BiDi Golden Rule states explicit right alignment reverses trailing edges under RTL. CT_TblPr demands bidiVisual precedes tblW.

desired_behavior: Strictly adhere to the OpenXML BiDi Golden Rule: omit <w:jc> for right alignment under RTL bidi. Strip any existing w:jc from RTL headings (this resolves contradiction with and supersedes LSN-2026-EXPLICIT-RIGHT-ALIGNMENT). Enforce w:jc w:val='both' on narrative body paragraphs. Use tblPr.insert(0, ...) for bidiVisual before tblW. Perform preamble table acronym sanitization pass. Refine auditor regex for Chapter 5.
generalization: OpenXML Bidi requires zero right-alignment tags for RTL to avoid trailing-edge flips, strict element ordering in tblPr, explicit justification for narrative prose, and semantic checks for chapter bounds.
